summary: DestProfilePrfClosures is a user control for managing Destination Profile Closures in an application, handling the display, filtering, and CRUD operations for closure records relating to a destination profile. Its main functionality includes filtering by closure type and discipline, managing which disciplines are included/excluded, and offering workflow-driven insert, update, and delete of closure records. It provides validation, handles exceptions, and controls UI elements depending on user permissions and data presence.
purpose: To provide an interactive interface for managing closure entries related to destination profiles, allowing users to filter, add, edit, or remove closures, select disciplines, and ensure that only authorized and valid closure data is processed.

workflows.name: Adding Closure
steps: User fills in closure fields (ClosureCode, StartDate, EndDate, Comments, Discipline selection)
If valid, GenericClosures.Add is called with parameters

workflows.name: Editing Closure
steps: User clicks Edit button for a row
If valid, GenericClosures.Update is called with parameters

workflows.name: Deleting Closure
steps: GenericClosures.Delete is called with SessionID and ClosureID

workflows.name: Discipline Selection
steps: User chooses to allow all disciplines or select from list
If selecting list, user moves disciplines between included and not included lists

business_rules: Closure cannot be inserted or updated unless all required fields are valid and Page.IsValid is true
Disciplines can be restricted based on user permissions
If RestrictedSubDisciplines is true, discipline filter is hidden and only allowed sub-disciplines can be selected
When no rows exist and screen is editable, empty data panel is shown
Closure can only be added, edited, or deleted if ScreenIsEditable is true
validations: Database operation canceled if UserSession is null
Form Controls must have values; empty or invalid values are defaulted or rejected
calculations: ValueList aggregates values from ListBox items to a comma-separated list
conditions: If UserSession is null, database selection is canceled
If RestrictedSubDisciplines is true, discipline filter hidden
If no rows and editable, empty data panel shown
system_behavior: Populates dropdowns and lists for closure types and disciplines
Redirects to current page after operation
Enables/disables UI elements based on editability
Handles CRUD operations through GenericClosures methods
Handles discipline selection dynamically based on allowed sub-disciplines
exceptions: Database selection or update canceled if UserSession is null
JavaScript errors for event validation when using EmptyDataTemplate
